bugs_found: review-validate/contract-validate/review-gate load schema/JSON files without handling FileNotFoundError or malformed schema JSON, causing uncaught crashes instead of documented exit code 2
review-validate and review-gate fallback to a literal branch path, allowing path traversal via branch values containing ../
review-gate does not enforce its documented requirement that the latest round overall has verdict=approve; it only checks the latest code-reviewer verdict
review-gate deduplicates findings by lexicographic filename order, not by round/agent chronology as the comment claims, so latest ack resolution can be computed incorrectly
contract-presence matches contract names globally per file, so one ---contract block named foo can satisfy multiple same-named nested/class functions without verifying placement or association
contract-presence parses invalid contract blocks but does not fail on parse errors; malformed contracts can still be ignored for presence semantics
